plugins.name: onfire-mcp-skills
plugins.description: Skill tree for the Onfire MCP. Atomic skills cover identity resolution, AI prospecting, contact enrichment and each signal layer (intent, hiring, events, community, developer activity, technology footprint, growth and role movement). Report skills generate account-research briefs and competitor intelligence. The weekly territory plan (the 5x5) runs a rep's recurring routine end to end: a scored account resolver, buying-committee coverage with warm-intro paths, on-demand contact data, and a durable artifact that refreshes on a schedule.
